# Trazo with splits — 2024

> Benchmark chips for South America (Trazo regions) cut from the 2024 edition of the harmonized field boundary collection wri_trazo_ml.

- [Collection](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/collection.json)
- [README](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/README.md)
- [Agent guide](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/AGENTS.md)
- [Field boundary lines](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/wri_trazo_ml_2024_boundary_lines.parquet)
- [Chip definitions with field coverage](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/wri_trazo_ml_2024_chips.parquet)
- [Chips (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/chips.pmtiles)
- [Field boundary polygons](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/wri_trazo_ml_2024_fields.parquet)
- [Field boundaries (PMTiles)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/fields.pmtiles)
- [STAC items in GeoParquet format (collection mirror)](https://data.source.coop/ftw/benchmark-data/wri_trazo_ml_2024/items.parquet)
